# plan:nav-home-prefetch — deliverable (coder/home-prefetch, pij-frequent-clownfish)

Answers request 01a1cd15-c61f-7190-baa2-ee4ed26bc882 (PRD items 3 and 5, plus the prime's scope add: idle git launches).

## Commits on main

- `dd9713a6e` perf(web): home page and idle servers stop running git per workspace (fast-forward on `0cc3821b9`).

Gate: `nice -n 19 just fft` on the final tree (on `0cc3821b9`), read in full: biome check + format clean (1805 files), turbo build 7/7, typecheck every tsconfig (apps/web, apps/cli, 5 packages, harness, test) clean, vitest 552 files / 7303 tests passed (60 skipped), `pnpm audit --audit-level=high` passed (3 low, 16 moderate below the threshold). Log: `/tmp/home-prefetch-fft-4.log`.

The built `.next` in `/Users/jordanknight/substrate/chainglass-home-prefetch` is from that run, at `dd9713a6e`; kept for the reviewer with the worktree and branch.

## What changed

- **Home page** (`apps/web/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx`): renders the card grid from the workspace registry alone. `WorkspaceGrid` fetches `/api/workspaces?include=worktrees` after load into a context; `WorkspaceWorktreeSummary` shows "… worktrees" until it arrives, then names (≤3) or a count. The grid's search still matches branch names (checked on prod: "ten-tv" filters to Cast AFL).
- **Worktree detection cache** (`packages/workflow/src/resolvers/git-worktree.resolver.ts`): `new GitWorktreeResolver(pm, { cache: { fileSystem } })` reuses a path's `detectWorktrees()` result until git's own metadata changes. The stamp is read by stat/readdir only (no process): linked worktree names under `<common>/worktrees/`, plus size and mtime of each git dir's `HEAD` (branch switch), `logs/HEAD` (commit, reset, checkout) and `gitdir` (worktree move). It works from a repo root, a linked worktree or a subdirectory. Failures are not cached. With the cache on, the git version check runs once. Paths outside any repo stay uncached. The web container (`apps/web/src/lib/di-container.ts`) registers one cached instance, so item 2 can reuse it. The CLI and workflow containers stay uncached.
- **Prefetch** (`prefetch={false}`) on link lists that grow with data:
  - home workspace cards
  - the three `workspace-nav` lists and `activity-dot`
  - `unit-list` and `unit-catalog-sidebar`
  - the `/workspaces` table
  - the four per-worktree links on `/workspaces/[slug]`

  Fixed nav links still prefetch.
- `DEPENDENCY_MAP.md` DC-04 documents the cache option.

## Evidence per acceptance item

Measured with my throwaway Playwright/curl probes against this branch's prod build on :3103 (`next start`, niced, bootstrap cookie from the worktree's `.chainglass/bootstrap-code.json`). All servers are now stopped.

| Item | Done when | Before | After (load) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | prod home HTML < 0.5 s, ~30 workspaces | PRD: 2.1–5.5 s. Jordan's :3000 this session: 10.6–42.4 s (load 57–157) | 0.011–0.020 s, 54 workspaces (load 96–119) |
| 5 | prod home ≤ 5 route prefetches on load | PRD: ~40 | 3 routes (`/workspaces`, `/pij`, `/settings/workspaces`, the fixed sidebar links), 6 HTTP requests (load 96–115) |
| 5 | work-units page none while idle | PRD: 32 requests in 30 s idle | 0 RSC/prefetch requests in 30 s idle; 0 in a separate 40 s trace (load 94–115) |
| scope add | idle steady state launches zero git | see below | worktree detection: met; other git classes: not met (see below) |

**Prefetch count: routes vs requests.** Next 16.4.2's segment cache sends 2 requests per prefetched link: `/_tree`, then a metadata-only request. Counted as routes, home is 3 (≤ 5). Counted as requests, it is 6. All of them are fixed links, so the number no longer grows with the workspace count.

**Why work-units re-prefetched while idle.** In Next 16.4.2, every visible prefetchable link is prefetched again when the router tree changes or when a server action revalidates:
- `app-router.js:109`, which calls `pingVisibleLinks`
- `segment-cache/cache.js:122`, called from `server-action-reducer.js:224` via `invalidateEntirePrefetchCache`

The per-unit link lists multiplied every such event. I could not reproduce the old idle repeats myself: Jordan's :3000 never rendered the page in 60 s at load 195. With the unit lists set to `prefetch={false}`, the page made 0 idle requests in two runs.

**Before numbers.** I could not take a same-session browser "before" for prefetch: :3000 did not render client-side within 60 s at load 104–195. The PRD baseline stands for those rows.

### Idle git launches (prime's scope add)

**How it was measured.** A `git` wrapper on PATH logged every launch. A `--require` preload recorded the JS stack of every `git worktree list` spawn. Both servers ran on :3103 with `TMUX` unset and `TMUX_TMPDIR=/tmp/home-prefetch-tmux`. I compared an origin/main build (in a scratch worktree, since removed) against this branch.

**Caller.** After boot, 144 of 201 `worktree list` spawns came from `/api/worktree-activity`. `useWorktreeActivity` polls it every 30 s per open tab, and the server runs `getInfo` for all 54 workspaces (54 lists + 54 version checks). That is about 3.6 launches/s per tab when the machine keeps up. The rest came from:
- 54: the sidebar's `/api/workspaces?include=worktrees`, on each navigation
- 3: page renders

At boot, the central watcher's data and source watchers each resolve every workspace.

Amended after review by pij-unaware-quokka and the prime. The first version said "158 -> 3". That 3 counts only `worktree list`; the window's total was 11. The data is unchanged. Each launch class is now listed separately:

| Window (load) | Git launch class | origin/main | dd9713a6e resolver |
|---|---|---|---|
| Boot | `worktree list` | 108 | 54 |
| Boot | `--version` | 108 | 1 |
| Idle, no client, 60 s (125–130) | all git | 0 | 0 (already 0 at baseline; not a change) |
| One idle tab on a workspace page, 120 s (107–137) | `worktree list` | 70 | 3 |
| same | `--version` | 88 | 0 |
| same | `status --porcelain=v1`, `log --name-only`, `diff --name-only`, `diff HEAD` (2 each) | 0 in that window | 8 |
| same | all git | 158 | 11 |

- **Worktree-detection classes** (`worktree list`, `--version`): this commit's scope. They went from 158 to 3. The 3 remaining lists were osk_central and unimatrix re-reading after real commits in their worktrees (`logs/HEAD` appends at those times).
- **The other 8** (`status`, `log`, `diff`): not touched by this commit. The prime attributes them to the browser page's change polling, which is trace-idle fix-c (mole's).
- **Before capture:** the shim logged every git launch with no filter; only the stack preload was limited to `worktree list`. So the before window really had no status/log/diff launches. [INFERENCE] Likely the origin/main server was still saturated by its worktree-detection backlog at load 137.
- **Rates:** the origin/main idle rate was throttled by load. Unthrottled, the worktree-activity poll alone is about 3.6 launches/s per tab.
- **dd9713a6e commit message:** it carries the same "158 -> 3" wording. It is pushed and cannot be amended; this deliverable is the correction of record.

## Tests added or changed

- `test/unit/workflow/git-worktree-resolver.test.ts`, 8 cache tests:
  - no cache means git runs on every call
  - unchanged metadata means one list and one version check
  - an added worktree is seen
  - a linked worktree commit or checkout re-reads
  - a main branch switch re-reads
  - lookup works from a linked worktree or a subdirectory
  - a path outside any repo is not cached
  - a failure is not cached
- `test/unit/web/features/041-file-browser/workspace-card.test.tsx`: the summary now comes from context. Added the loading placeholder case; the count and name cases were rewritten.

## Kept deliberately / not done

- Fixed sidebar links (`/`, `/workspaces`, `/pij`, `/settings/workspaces`, new-worktree) still prefetch. They are constant, not data-scaled.
- `/api/workspaces?include=worktrees` is fetched twice on home (the grid and the sidebar). With the cache, the second fetch runs no git. Client-side dedupe of that endpoint is PRD item 8, not done here.
- `Worktree.head` (the SHA) can lag in one case: when a branch ref moves without its worktree's `logs/HEAD` changing (for example, pushed from another worktree). No consumer reads `head` today.
- The prod measurements above came from the build before `e37b1ea0d` (ssr-dashboard) and `d63f92503` (strip-067) landed. The final fft build includes both. I did not re-probe it.
- The earlier full run (load ~100) had 30 real-git test timeouts in files I did not touch. The final run at load ~58 had none.
